My dear [Miss Dampier](../persons.html#1345),
Here are your books with many thanks, and the Scotch one.

It is the Edinburgh baillie who is worth reading—the other is horrid. I will get the rest of Mademoiselle as soon as I can and send her or bring her.[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Perhaps Mémoires de Mademoiselle de Montpensier ed.

Adolphe Cheruel 4 vols (Paris: Charpentier 1858-9).
